CHURN_REACHED_ORIGIN_AND_WAS_REVERTED_FO: The churn commit edb170f DID reach origin/main, and this is how. The coordinator reset it locally to 4536bd6 and rebuilt the push as 086aac8 carrying the checkpoint alone, 5600 bytes against the earlier 989171-byte bundle. device_commit_files was then called with force true on the SAME devicePath '~/100 Aero Prods/aerospace-100-mission/inc.bundle' and returned written with no rejection - but the file that landed on the Mac was the EARLIER 989171-byte bundle, verified by stat on the device after the fact. The bridge served a stale copy of a path it had already transferred this session, and force did not defeat it. So the Mac ff-merged and pushed edb170f, the commit that had been reset precisely because it was churn. NEW DEFECT, OWNER SHOULD KNOW: every future push must use a UNIQUE bundle filename per push, and the device-side bundle's size or checksum must be verified BEFORE the fetch, not after the push. Remediated FORWARD, never by rewriting published history: the seventeen churned blobs were restored from 6000be2, the .gitignore guard was re-applied from 4536bd6, and this commit carries the correct checkpoint. The churn is in the published history of the monorepo and is left there, visible, with this record.
